series_T.objective: Create a code tour that traces the complete path from SQL query reception to parsing completion
criteria: Must trace from client query receipt to parsed representation
Must identify at least 3 functions in the call chain
Must explain the role of each function
Must provide file and line references for each step

criteria: Must identify pg_analyze_and_rewrite as a key function

series_T.objective: Extend the executor tour to explain expression evaluation

series_T.objective: Create a code tour that explains index access methods

Must explain how index scans work
Must describe the relationship between index and heap access

series_T.objective: Create a code tour that explains sorting and aggregation
criteria: Must identify sorting implementation in nodeSort.c
Must explain aggregation mechanisms in nodeAgg.c
Must describe how ORDER BY and GROUP BY are processed
Must trace at least one sort or aggregation operation

series_T.objective: Create a code tour that explains locking and concurrency control
criteria: Must identify lock manager as concurrency control mechanism
Must explain different lock types (row, table, page)
Must describe lock acquisition and release
Must trace locking in at least one operation

series_T.objective: Create a code tour that explains vacuum and maintenance operations
criteria: Must identify VACUUM as a maintenance command
Must explain what vacuum does (dead tuple removal, stats update)
Must describe lazy vacuum mechanism
Must trace vacuum execution for a table

series_T.objective: Create a code tour that explains checkpoints and recovery
criteria: Must identify CheckpointWrite as checkpoint initiation
Must explain checkpoint process and WAL flushing
Must describe recovery procedure
Must trace checkpoint creation and recovery steps

series_T.objective: Create a code tour that explains access method interface and extensibility
criteria: Must identify the access method interface
Must explain how different access methods implement the interface
Must describe extensibility mechanism for new access methods
Must trace at least one access method operation

evaluation_criteria.correct: The response is relevant and central relations are accurate
evaluation_criteria.evidence_supported: All claims are supported by evidence from the code
evaluation_criteria.major_missing_relation: A major expected relation is absent

notes: This is a sealed question set. Questions and expectations are not revealed to agents during benchmarking.
